etymology.historical_story: Shelly is recorded as an English personal name and a spelling variant of Shelley. In a Malay sentence, such a name identifies a person rather than acquiring a new Malay dictionary meaning. Its appearance in a frequency list therefore does not establish a Malay lexical origin or official dictionary status. See [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/shelly).
